description:
How did PFAS chemicals once used in popular stain-resistant carpets end up in the water and environment in parts of Georgia, Alabama and South Carolina?

FRONTLINE, @AssociatedPress, @ajcvideo, @postandcourier, and @aldotcom investigate what happened with these forever chemicals and the ongoing health impacts.
